general.description: Any ship pretending to enter the Ashioto Cluster from the Core League must dock at Ohashi Border Station and submit to a thorough search. Security is strict and any attempt at smuggling a Purgatorian relic from the Inner Cluster is very likely to be detected.
general.bar: Spacers, Ashioto Research Board policepeople and scientists, that's the only patrons you'll find here.
